title: The title screen is calmer: flat step columns and one pitch for the mode rows
why: The critic scored the title 2 of 5 on the shared look (template page, step cards that read as buttons, five amber things, mode rows at 56/48/48/48/40/48/40, no pad focus cue). The cards are now flat columns under a 1px rule with the step number in the accent, every mode row is 48px on the 8px grid, the save buttons are ghost with light text, key caps use the 14px size, and a focus bar marks the row a pad is on. No wording moved.
now: The title screen has fewer boxes and one row height, with a focus bar on the menu row.
